steps.title: What you are looking at
body: This panel shows one **step** of a course an agent wrote for you.
- `a`: ask the agent; your step and `file:line` are attached
Press `n`: the next step opens a file and highlights the lines it explains.

steps.title: nvim-tour-axi load: config over the socket

marks.text: replace any earlier instance, then start

body: Loading is two Lua evaluations in your Neovim, nothing more:
2. drop any loaded copy of the module and call `setup` with the course, the project root, the language and the transport.
Nothing is written to your config, so closing Neovim forgets the tour.

steps.title: Where your questions go
body: `auto` picks the agent's own terminal: its Rex block, else its tmux pane, else an inbox file next to the course.
The multiplexer binary is passed as an absolute path because a Neovim started by the multiplexer may not inherit the agent's `PATH`.

steps.title: Anchors survive edits
body: A step may name an `anchor`: text expected on its first line.
If the file changed and the anchor moved, the plugin searches up to 200 lines around it and shifts the highlight, the label and every note by the same offset, marking the step `[moved]`.

steps.title: Live reload
body: The agent appends chapters while you read. A file watcher reloads the course, keeps you on the same step by its `id`, and re-arms itself because an atomic write replaces the file it was watching.
This is the last step. Press `a` and ask the agent anything.
